# Verification Record Template

## Identification

- Test-case ID: `<PROJECT>-TC-####`
- Verification ID: `<PROJECT>-VER-####`
- Title:
- Protocol version/status:
- Linked requirement and risk-control IDs:
- Test level/method:
- Author, executor, reviewer, and roles:

## Controlled configuration

- Source commit/build/artifact digest:
- Test environment and configuration:
- Tool/runtime/model/prompt/dataset versions as applicable:
- Fixtures, prerequisites, and external dependencies:
- Execution date/time:

## Procedure and acceptance criteria

Record approved steps, expected results, quantitative criteria, boundaries, and required evidence before execution.

## Execution results

For each step record actual result, pass/fail/not run, and evidence link. Do not replace raw output with a narrative summary when raw evidence can be retained.

## Deviations and anomalies

- Protocol deviations:
- Unexpected results:
- Linked `<PROJECT>-ANOM-####` records:
- Reruns and relationship to prior runs:

## Conclusion

- Overall result: Pass / Fail / Incomplete
- Requirements with passing evidence:
- Requirements not demonstrated:
- Limitations and regression implications:

## Review and approval

Agents leave approval fields unapproved.

- Independent review decision/date:
- Quality acceptance where required:
